description: This file contains test helper functions for mocking objects related to follow-up runs and typing controllers in a chat or messaging system. It defines functions to create mocked instances of TypingController and FollowupRun with customizable overrides.

methods.name: export function createMockTypingController( createMockTypingController
methods.description: Creates a mock implementation of the TypingController with default stubbed functions, allowing optional overrides.

methods.name: export function createMockFollowupRun( createMockFollowupRun
methods.description: Creates a mocked FollowupRun object with default properties, with optional overrides to customize its behavior.
